typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EBillPreferenceArchiveFilePath as string (),
	EBillPreferenceFilePath as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutFileName as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutPath as string (),
	FacetsDataSource as string (),
	FacetsPassword as string (),
	FacetsUserID as string (),
	TestVaraible as string (),
	varFilePath as string ()
}

source(output(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		MESSAGE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT    EPS.GRGR_ID,    EPS.SBSB_ID,    EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT,    EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT,    \'Invalid SubscriberId\' AS MESSAGE  FROM    AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS     JOIN CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON EPS.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID    LEFT JOIN CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON EPS.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  WHERE SBSB.SBSB_ID IS NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> InValidSubscriberIDs
InValidSubscriberIDs sink(input(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		MESSAGE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EBILL_EFF_DT,
		MESSAGE,
		GRGR_ID,
		EBILL_TERM_DT,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> FlatFileDestination
